visual_style.direction: 精致 Instagram 职场纪实写真，暖白自然光，奶油白、浅橡木、暖灰、海军蓝和少量鼠尾草绿；自然肤质、真实织物与生活细节，人物面貌姣好但表现专业，男女均担任候选人和面试官。面试室、玻璃会议室、桌面编码面试、白板技术面、安静远程面试均合理使用，不能把全部图片做成同一张会议桌摆拍。中近景与环境中景交替，保留完整学习道具与人脸；上方自然墙面、下方桌面适量留白供后续叠加标签。无底图标题、气泡或文字，技术屏幕和白板只保留无字图形或不可辨认的背景内容。视觉只能说明人物在面试讨论，不能凭面貌认定国籍、岗位能力、情绪故事、薪酬或某个技术结论。人物地区是虚构演员设定；美国演员不限定单一族裔。 用户 2026-10-09 生成过程中追加要求艺术感、电影感：后续所有场景与封面在既有无字、真实、4:5、Instagram 职场纪实基础上，采用现代职场电影剧照方向——有意图的非居中构图、前中后景层次、真实窗侧光、克制负补光、柔和深阴影与受控高光，肤色暖白自然、背景阴影微冷、色彩克制、轻微 35mm 胶片颗粒；依靠眼神、停顿与手势叙事，关键道具与面貌清晰，保留 4:5 无黑边。演员仍为多地区成年虚构演员轮换。

categories.title: 面试开场与自我介绍
categories.goal: 简洁介绍背景、技术经验与求职动机，解释与岗位的匹配。
categories.visual_direction_zh: 温暖明亮的初轮面试，靠窗的小会议室、浅木桌和一两件求职道具。人物从略紧张到从容，以倾听、眼神和自然手势表现开场；画面亲近但保留正式面试边界。

categories.title: 项目经历与成果表达
categories.goal: 讲清项目背景、个人贡献、技术挑战和可核实的结果。
categories.visual_direction_zh: 项目经历面试，候选人展示真实工作成果，面试官追问贡献与结果。用笔记本、简洁无字图表与项目资料带出讨论，不用堆满屏幕或夸张庆功姿势。

categories.title: 算法与现场编码
categories.goal: 澄清题意，边解题边说明思路，解释复杂度并应对提示。
categories.visual_direction_zh: 编码面试的专注与轻微压力，桌面保持克制，电脑、纸和笔可辨。以停顿、思考、解释和接受提示形成变化，不用炫酷黑客屏幕、霓虹或紧张汗滴。

categories.title: 技术基础与原理问答
categories.goal: 用清晰英语解释常见技术概念、区别和适用条件。
categories.visual_direction_zh: 原理问答采用干净白板或纸面示意，面试官与候选人共同讨论。白板只用少量无字线条、节点、框和箭头；人物仍是主角，技术概念的正确性由后续对白明确。

categories.title: 系统设计与技术取舍
categories.goal: 先确认需求与规模，再说明设计、替代方案和取舍。
categories.visual_direction_zh: 白板系统设计面试，干净的玻璃会议室、适量空间和少量架构草图。动作体现先听需求、再提出设计与比较取舍，不把人物缩成复杂巨型图的陪衬。

categories.title: 工程实践与问题排查
categories.goal: 在面试给定的代码或故障场景中说明测试、排查、改进与交付步骤。
categories.visual_direction_zh: 工程实战问答，面试官给出代码、测试或故障场景，候选人依据证据解释排查步骤。桌面只留当前必要物件，屏幕用克制图形暗示资料，保持理性与真实。

categories.title: 行为面试与团队协作
categories.goal: 用具体经历说明沟通、责任、判断与成长；STAR 指情境、任务、行动、结果。
categories.visual_direction_zh: 行为面试突出真实的人际交流与细腻表情，暖白会议室、两张椅子和薄笔记本即可。讲述过往经历时保持当前面试现场，不将抽象词画成情绪符号或戏剧化冲突。

categories.title: 反问与面试后续
categories.goal: 了解岗位、团队和成长空间，并得体沟通薪酬、入职与面试结果。
categories.visual_direction_zh: 面试收尾与招聘沟通，氛围轻松但专业，既有会议室反问也有安静远程跟进。文件夹、日历、电脑表达实际沟通场景，不用金钱、礼物或庆祝符号替代薪酬与Offer。

cards.title_zh: 用一分钟介绍自己
cards.scene_zh: 亚洲女候选人在初轮面试用自然手势做一分钟介绍，欧洲女面试官专注倾听。
cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Hana, a fictional attractive 29-year-old East Asian woman from South Korea, with warm fair skin, expressive brown eyes, an oval face, straight shoulder-length dark hair tucked behind one ear, and subtle natural makeup. Her appearance is individual and realistic, not a beauty stereotype.
Interviewer or recruiter: Sofia, a fictional attractive 33-year-old European woman from France, with light olive skin, hazel eyes, softly wavy chestnut hair cut just above the shoulders, subtle freckles, and understated natural makeup.
Exactly two people in a small sunlit interview room. Hana wears a cream blouse and navy blazer; Sofia wears a sage blouse. Hana has just started her one-minute introduction, holding a relaxed open palm near the tabletop and making calm eye contact with Sofia. Sofia listens with a pen resting on a closed notebook. A slim resume folder and a glass of water sit between them. Frame a candid medium two-person shot at seated eye level with a natural 50mm lens perspective; include both faces and the resume folder. Soft morning window light, quiet confidence, no handshake or posing toward the camera.

image_review.summary: 两位女性对话自然，候选人开放手势、面试官握笔和脸部未见明显结构异常；玻璃杯、文件夹与笔记本清楚，窗侧光与远侧阴影、前景植物形成层次。相较初版更有电影剧照气氛 实际可见物件：桌面前方深色薄文件夹；不把文件夹外观当成简历内容证明。

cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Maya, a fictional attractive 30-year-old American woman of mixed heritage, with warm tan skin, brown eyes, dark shoulder-length loose curls, a softly defined face, and minimal natural makeup.
Interviewer or recruiter: Arjun, a fictional handsome 32-year-old South Asian man from India, with medium-brown skin, thoughtful dark eyes, short softly textured black hair, a neatly trimmed light beard, and a relaxed, professional presence.
Exactly two people in a bright contemporary company interview room. Maya, in a cream blouse with a navy blazer, explains why the role interests her to Arjun, in a stone-gray shirt. Maya shows a small, genuine smile and a restrained open-hand gesture; Arjun listens with an open notebook. Through the frosted glass, only soft shapes of empty desks are visible, with no extra people or brand signage. Use a 50mm medium portrait from slightly off the table corner, keeping both faces clear and the office context subtle. Diffuse late-morning light, pale oak, a warm but credible conversation rather than a recruitment advertisement.

cards.scene_zh: 欧洲女候选人说明职业空档或转岗经历，亚洲女招聘方在日历与简历旁倾听。
cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Sofia, a fictional attractive 33-year-old European woman from France, with light olive skin, hazel eyes, softly wavy chestnut hair cut just above the shoulders, subtle freckles, and understated natural makeup.
Interviewer or recruiter: Hana, a fictional attractive 29-year-old East Asian woman from South Korea, with warm fair skin, expressive brown eyes, an oval face, straight shoulder-length dark hair tucked behind one ear, and subtle natural makeup. Her appearance is individual and realistic, not a beauty stereotype.
Exactly two people in a quiet interview room. Sofia, the candidate in a cream knit top and charcoal blazer, explains a career transition to Hana, the recruiter in a navy blouse. Sofia lightly indicates a paper with a few blank timeline blocks beside her resume folder, then meets Hana's eyes with a composed expression. Hana listens with her pen resting, not interrogating. Keep the paper unlettered and visually secondary; it is a conversation aid, not proof of the candidate's history. A three-quarter 50mm medium shot, diffuse afternoon daylight, tidy oak table and a single ceramic water cup. No travel montage, graduation costume or pitying mood.

cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Hana, a fictional attractive 29-year-old East Asian woman from South Korea, with warm fair skin, expressive brown eyes, an oval face, straight shoulder-length dark hair tucked behind one ear, and subtle natural makeup. Her appearance is individual and realistic, not a beauty stereotype.
Interviewer or recruiter: Maya, a fictional attractive 30-year-old American woman of mixed heritage, with warm tan skin, brown eyes, dark shoulder-length loose curls, a softly defined face, and minimal natural makeup.
Exactly two people discussing project ownership during an interview. Hana, in a sage blouse, indicates one modest section of a printed unlabeled three-part workflow with the tip of a pen. Maya, in a navy blazer, watches her explain what she personally contributed. The other hand of each person rests naturally on the table; a closed laptop sits to one side. Use a slightly elevated 50mm three-quarter view that includes their faces and the whole sheet, not a hand-only crop. Soft neutral daylight, quiet concentration and believable desk textures. Do not use a spotlight, trophy or glowing outline to suggest ownership; the story will be supplied by the dialogue.

cards.title_zh: 用数据说明项目成果
cards.scene_zh: 美国女候选人用无字趋势图说明项目成果，欧洲女面试官追问测量方法。
cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Maya, a fictional attractive 30-year-old American woman of mixed heritage, with warm tan skin, brown eyes, dark shoulder-length loose curls, a softly defined face, and minimal natural makeup.
Interviewer or recruiter: Sofia, a fictional attractive 33-year-old European woman from France, with light olive skin, hazel eyes, softly wavy chestnut hair cut just above the shoulders, subtle freckles, and understated natural makeup.
Exactly two people in a project-impact interview. Maya, in an ivory blouse, shows Sofia, in a charcoal blazer, a laptop with a simple unlabeled comparison chart: two small muted bar groups and a discreet trend line. Maya speaks with quiet confidence, an open hand near the laptop rather than a finger covering the screen. Sofia watches thoughtfully with a pen beside her notebook. A 50mm eye-level medium shot keeps both faces and the complete laptop visible. Soft late-morning daylight, restrained cream and sage colors, real skin texture. No readable metrics, currency, trophies, exaggerated success smile or claim that the photograph proves a measured outcome.

cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Marcus, a fictional handsome 36-year-old Black American man, with deep-brown skin, attentive brown eyes, short tightly curled black hair, a closely trimmed beard, and a calm, approachable expression.
Interviewer or recruiter: Lukas, a fictional handsome 35-year-old European man from Sweden, with fair skin, gray-green eyes, short light-brown hair, light stubble, and natural smile lines.
Exactly two people in a live coding interview. Marcus, wearing a pale-blue shirt, looks toward Lukas, the interviewer in a charcoal overshirt, while explaining his next coding step. One of Marcus's hands rests naturally on the laptop keyboard; the other makes a low, modest gesture beside an open notebook. Lukas sits diagonally opposite, attentive and unhurried. The laptop has softly indistinct horizontal editor blocks, no readable code. A 50mm medium environmental photograph from a side corner keeps hands, both faces and the whole laptop in view. Neutral daylight, natural skin texture, quiet focus, believable posture without exaggerated multitasking.

cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Lukas, a fictional handsome 35-year-old European man from Sweden, with fair skin, gray-green eyes, short light-brown hair, light stubble, and natural smile lines.
Interviewer or recruiter: Arjun, a fictional handsome 32-year-old South Asian man from India, with medium-brown skin, thoughtful dark eyes, short softly textured black hair, a neatly trimmed light beard, and a relaxed, professional presence.
Exactly two people at a technical interview. Lukas, the candidate in a white shirt and charcoal blazer, stands near a small whiteboard containing two sparse unlabeled growth-curve sketches, without formulas, numbers or exact complexity labels. He holds the marker lowered and explains the trade-off to Arjun, the seated interviewer in a light-blue shirt. Arjun keeps a slim notebook on the table. A 35mm medium environmental shot shows the people clearly and the whiteboard only as a modest discussion aid. Diffuse daylight, pale oak, realistic marker marks and thoughtful expressions. The mathematical meaning belongs in the later dialogue, not in invented visible notation.

cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Sofia, a fictional attractive 33-year-old European woman from France, with light olive skin, hazel eyes, softly wavy chestnut hair cut just above the shoulders, subtle freckles, and understated natural makeup.
Interviewer or recruiter: Hana, a fictional attractive 29-year-old East Asian woman from South Korea, with warm fair skin, expressive brown eyes, an oval face, straight shoulder-length dark hair tucked behind one ear, and subtle natural makeup. Her appearance is individual and realistic, not a beauty stereotype.
Exactly two people discussing a cache decision during a system-design interview. Sofia, in a navy knit top, shows Hana, in a cream blazer, a sparse whiteboard diagram: one short branch through a small rounded box and a second, longer branch through two simple boxes. The drawing is unlabeled. Sofia holds her marker away from her face and explains the trade-off, while Hana listens with a pen beside an open notebook. A 35mm medium environmental view includes both people and the small board. Diffuse morning light, pale-oak table and natural clothing folds. No glowing speed effects, stopwatch graphics or suggestion that caching always guarantees a better outcome.

cards.scene_zh: 亚洲女候选人与美国女面试官讨论扩容、可靠性和成本，不用价格或炫目数据作装饰。
cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Hana, a fictional attractive 29-year-old East Asian woman from South Korea, with warm fair skin, expressive brown eyes, an oval face, straight shoulder-length dark hair tucked behind one ear, and subtle natural makeup. Her appearance is individual and realistic, not a beauty stereotype.
Interviewer or recruiter: Maya, a fictional attractive 30-year-old American woman of mixed heritage, with warm tan skin, brown eyes, dark shoulder-length loose curls, a softly defined face, and minimal natural makeup.
Exactly two people in a system-design trade-off interview. Hana, in a sage blouse and navy blazer, compares two compact unlabeled architecture options on a paper sheet with Maya, in an ivory knit top. One option has a single service box; the other has two balanced branches and a small storage shape. Hana keeps a pen beside the alternatives while explaining cost and reliability considerations, and Maya listens thoughtfully. An open laptop sits quietly to the side. A slightly elevated 50mm medium view includes their faces and the complete sheet. Soft afternoon daylight, restrained colors. No currency amounts, scales of justice, trophies or futuristic infrastructure.

Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. Candidate: Lukas, a fictional handsome 35-year-old European man from Sweden, with fair skin, gray-green eyes, short light-brown hair, light stubble, and natural smile lines.
Interviewer or recruiter: Arjun, a fictional handsome 32-year-old South Asian man from India, with medium-brown skin, thoughtful dark eyes, short softly textured black hair, a neatly trimmed light beard, and a relaxed, professional presence.
Exactly two people reviewing tests during a coding interview. Lukas, in a light-blue shirt, studies an open laptop and adds a small circular check mark beside an unlabeled sketch in his notebook. Arjun, the interviewer in a charcoal overshirt, sits diagonally across the table and watches the explanation with a thoughtful expression. cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Maya, a fictional attractive 30-year-old American woman of mixed heritage, with warm tan skin, brown eyes, dark shoulder-length loose curls, a softly defined face, and minimal natural makeup.
Interviewer or recruiter: Sofia, a fictional attractive 33-year-old European woman from France, with light olive skin, hazel eyes, softly wavy chestnut hair cut just above the shoulders, subtle freckles, and understated natural makeup.
Exactly two people in a code-review interview exercise. Maya, wearing a cream blouse, studies a laptop before turning to Sofia, in a navy blazer, to explain one improvement. Maya holds a pen near a small notebook, keeping her hands naturally low and clear of the screen; Sofia listens without taking over the keyboard. The display contains softly indistinct horizontal editor blocks only. A 50mm eye-level medium frame includes both faces, the laptop and a thin project folder. Gentle side-window daylight, a quiet oak desk and candid concentration. No giant highlighted source code, projected overlays or exaggerated pointing at an unreadable wall display.

cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.

Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.

Marcus stands naturally beside the board with the marker lowered as Lukas asks about verification. An open notebook rests on a clean table. Use a 35mm medium environmental photograph, diffuse afternoon window light, plausible board reflections and real fabric creases. No rocket launches, warning sirens, broken servers or dramatic nighttime operations room.

cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Lukas, a fictional handsome 35-year-old European man from Sweden, with fair skin, gray-green eyes, short light-brown hair, light stubble, and natural smile lines.
Interviewer or recruiter: Arjun, a fictional handsome 32-year-old South Asian man from India, with medium-brown skin, thoughtful dark eyes, short softly textured black hair, a neatly trimmed light beard, and a relaxed, professional presence.
Exactly two people during a behavioral interview about taking responsibility. Lukas, in a pale-blue shirt and charcoal blazer, explains an experience with a steady, modest expression to Arjun, in an ivory shirt. Lukas rests one hand on a small closed notebook and uses the other for a gentle explanatory gesture; Arjun listens across the table, pen resting beside a thin folder. A 50mm medium environmental frame keeps both faces and naturally formed hands visible. Soft side-window light, calm cream and oak interior, confident but unshowy body language. No heroic pose, medal, raised fist or visual claim that a person's appearance proves leadership.

cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.

Arjun, in a light-blue shirt, listens carefully to Marcus, the interviewer in a charcoal overshirt, then makes a small note in an otherwise unlettered notebook. Arjun's expression is receptive and thoughtful, his pen held naturally; Marcus speaks with a calm, specific gesture near the tabletop. cards.image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE 4:5 portrait photograph, a refined Instagram workplace editorial captured during a believable programmer job interview. Attractive, well-groomed adult actors in understated professional clothing; candid interaction, not runway posing. Warm-white daylight, cream walls, pale oak, warm gray, restrained navy and sage accents. Natural skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, flyaway hair, realistic fabric creases and material texture; polished exposure without beauty-filter smoothing. Keep faces, naturally formed hands and the essential interview prop clearly visible. Leave gentle breathing room in the upper wall and lower tabletop for later labels, with no artificial blank bands. One coherent photographic moment with plausible perspective, grounded shadows and restrained depth of field. No readable writing, letters, numbers, code, captions, speech bubbles, interface overlays, logos or watermark. Screens and papers may contain only discreet unlabeled shapes or content softened beyond legibility. Avoid plastic skin, excessive HDR, orange color cast, exaggerated bokeh, duplicated people and deformed anatomy.
Cinematic art direction: an artful still frame from a contemporary workplace drama with a refined Instagram editorial finish. Use intentional off-center framing, layered foreground, people and background, realistic directional window side light, gentle negative fill on the shadow side, controlled highlights and rich soft shadows. Keep skin tones warm-neutral with subtly cooler background shadows, a restrained film palette, delicate 35mm film grain and natural fine texture. Build quiet narrative tension through the existing glances, pauses and gestures. Keep the interview setting clean and believable, essential props recognizable, and faces readable. Preserve the 4:5 portrait composition without black bars; avoid heavy teal-orange grading, crushed blacks, theatrical spotlights and artificial glamour.
Candidate: Marcus, a fictional handsome 36-year-old Black American man, with deep-brown skin, attentive brown eyes, short tightly curled black hair, a closely trimmed beard, and a calm, approachable expression.
Interviewer or recruiter: Lukas, a fictional handsome 35-year-old European man from Sweden, with fair skin, gray-green eyes, short light-brown hair, light stubble, and natural smile lines.
Exactly two people near the end of an interview. Marcus, the candidate in a stone-gray shirt and navy blazer, asks Lukas, the interviewer in a pale-blue shirt, a question about the team and role. Marcus leans forward slightly with attentive eye contact; Lukas answers with a restrained open-hand gesture. A thin folder and one closed laptop sit on the table, and an indistinct empty workspace appears behind frosted glass. A 50mm medium environmental photograph, soft afternoon window light and believable room depth. The candidate is actively asking, not passively waiting. No extra colleagues, company branding or staged handshake.

caption.en: A candidate discusses how to respond to an offer after reviewing the terms.
caption.zh: 审阅条款后，候选人讨论如何回复录用通知。

description.en: A candidate discusses how to respond to an offer after reviewing the terms.
description.zh: 审阅条款后，候选人讨论如何回复录用通知。

roles.B: Interviewer or recruiter 面试官/招聘方

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for the offer. May I review the written terms in this folder?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你们的录用通知。我可以审阅这个文件夹里的书面条款吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Of course. When can you let us know whether you accept?
dialogue.zh: 当然。你什么时候能告诉我们是否接受？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll respond by Friday. If I need to decline, I'll let you know promptly and thank you for your time.
dialogue.zh: 我会在周五前回复。如果我需要谢绝，我会及时告知，并感谢你们付出的时间。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: That works. Please contact me if you have any questions.
dialogue.zh: 可以。有任何问题请联系我。
